remove.doc: Removes consumers instead of adding one: 'all', or a type name from this list, e.g. 'items'.

item.doc: Adds a single-item consumer; shorthand for consumeItem(item).

items.doc: Also accepts a single ItemStack, or a full ConsumeItems object.

itemsBoost.doc: Like 'items', but marked as a boost input (Consume#booster).

liquids.doc: Also accepts a full ConsumeLiquids object.

liquidsBoost.doc: Like 'liquids', but marked as a boost input (Consume#booster).

power.doc: Also accepts a full ConsumePower object, e.g. for buffered power.

powerBuffered.doc: Shorthand for a buffered power consumer with this capacity.
